text: dsh-plugin-list-plus（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：在 Web 设置中提供按信任层级浏览的增强插件清单。它在官方插件列表旁注册独立标签，并由 Node 端读取 Loader 与包信息生成快照。主要功能有官方、组织和个人分组，组内搜索与排序，分组折叠，以及展开查看版本、开发者、许可证、配置和挂载状态；快照不可用时回退到官方清单。适合需要在设置页管理和了解已配置插件的用户，不需要额外密钥或外部账号。

dsh-plugin-list-plus adds a catalog tab to DSH Web Settings. It groups plugins by publisher tier, supports search and collapsible groups, and shows package and mount details. It reads a Loader snapshot and falls back to the official inventory if unavailable. No extra key or account is needed.
想在 DSH 设置页按官方、组织和个人分组查看已安装插件。
有没有办法快速搜索某个已配置插件的名称和描述？
我想展开插件条目查看版本、许可证和开发者信息。
插件列表太长了，能把不常看的信任分组折叠起来吗？
如何检查某个插件是启用状态还是已经挂载？
想在官方插件列表旁边加一个包含更多包详情的独立标签。
How can I browse configured plugins grouped by publisher trust tier?
I need to search the plugin catalog and inspect package metadata in Web Settings.
dsh-plugin-list-plus 的功能「信任分组」：将清单分为官方、组织和个人组，组内按显示名称排序。打开设置中的独立标签即可浏览。
dsh-plugin-list-plus 的功能「搜索」：在插件列表标签的搜索框输入查询，过滤匹配的插件条目，并隐藏没有匹配项的分组。
dsh-plugin-list-plus 的功能「插件详情」：展开插件卡片查看版本、开发者、描述、许可证、主页、仓库、配置和 Cordis 挂载状态。
dsh-plugin-list-plus 的功能「折叠分组」：点击分组标题可收起或展开该信任组，减少长清单占用的页面空间。

dsh-plugin-list-plus README · dsh-plugin-list-plus：An elevated Plugin list for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web Settings — trust tiers, collapsible groups, and complete per-plugin detail. It adds a **Plugin list Plus** tab beside the official **Plugin list** tab, offering:

dsh-plugin-list-plus README · dsh-plugin-list-plus：- **Trust tiers** — plugins are grouped into Official / Organization / Personal: the `@deepseek-ai` scope and `cordis:` builtins are official, any other npm scope is an organization, and unscoped or local-file plugins are personal.
- **Collapsible groups** — a dense tier folds from its header so the others stay in reach without scrolling.
- **Full details** — one card per plugin: display name, version, git commit, developer, description, license, homepage, repository, bundle patch, configuration status, and Cordis mount status.
- **Search & sort** — filter by name, description, developer, and other fields; each tier keeps a stable name order.
dsh-plugin-list-plus README · Install：```sh
dsh-plugin-list-plus README · from the built tarball：dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-plugin-list-plus-0.1.0.tgz

dsh-plugin-list-plus README · or from npm once published：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-list-plus
```

Restart `dsh web`, then open **Settings → Plugins → Plugin list Plus** — a new tab beside the official **Plugin list**.

dsh-plugin-list-plus README · How it works：- **Node half** (`src/index.ts`, the package `main`): reads the Loader tree and installed `package.json` files, computes the trust-tiered snapshot, and serves it at `GET /plugins/dsh-plugin-list-plus/list` — an **exact** route, so it never shadows the plugin's own browser bundle under `/plugins/<name>/client.js`.
- **Browser half** (`src/client/`, the package `./client`): registers its own Plugin list tab (`settings.plugins.tab` id `plus`, order `20`) beside the official one and renders the enhanced list.

dsh-plugin-list-plus README · How it works：Because DeepSeek Harness has a tab-projection bug (`ui-settings-plugins` reads `entries()` instead of `entriesOfSlot()`, so shadowing the official tab would show a duplicate) and accepts no external changes to fix it, this plugin ships as a separate tab.

dsh-plugin-list-plus README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run build     # tsc (d.ts) + tsdown (lib/index.mjs + lib/client.js)
pnpm test          # vitest (node half + browser half + components)
pnpm run typecheck # strict typecheck of src and tests

The browser half bundles to the harness client-bundle contract (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load`), resolving `react`, `react/jsx-runtime`, and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` from the runtime module table.
